title: News

story.headline: Apple may cut the Small Business commission to 10%, a report says
story.body: Bloomberg cites two people familiar with the plans; Apple hasn’t commented. The change would start in 2027.
story.why: Trailhead is in the Small Business Program. If it happens, you’d keep about $340 more a month at September’s revenue. Nothing to do yet.

fallback_text: [Rumor] Apple may cut the Small Business commission to 10%, a report says (Bloomberg, two unnamed sources; Apple hasn’t commented). Why it matters: Trailhead is in the program; you’d keep about $340 more a month at September’s revenue. Nothing to do yet.
